{{Quote|My noble colleagues, less than an hour ago, an assassination attempt was made against my life. One of my bodyguards and six others were ruthlessly and senselessly murdered.|Padmé Amidala, before the Galactic Senate|<ref name="AOTC" />}}
'''Versé''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as one of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]] during the end of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].

==Biography==
Like all the other [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]], Versé was trained in self-defense and marksmanship. Her rigorous training was supervised by [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] head of security, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Typho]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 28">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 28|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 28]]</ref>

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Amidala was en route to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] for the vote on the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]], which she was firmly opposed to. Versé accompanied her fellow handmaiden, [[Cordé/Legends|Cordé]], to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] while the latter was impersonating Amidala and their mistress was posing as a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] flying escort for the [[J-type diplomatic barge/Legends|Naboo Royal Cruiser]]. Upon their arrival, Versé, Cordé, and five [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Naboo guards]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] meant for Amidala, courtesy of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]].<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Versé was portrayed by [[Avril Wynne]] in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="Royal Handmaidens Guide">{{SW|url=news/a-guide-to-the-royal-handmaidens|text=A Guide to the Royal Handmaidens of Naboo}}</ref>
